comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: From what I can tell, this item is only available during certain events (Merry Christmas! In 2010, New France development team, 1st Age Memorial, possibly others). I know for a fact the pre-2nd Age launch event 1st Memorial was skipped on GAMA, the same as the pre-Gran Atlas event. I'm less sure of the other events, but if this has been available in GAMA's past, I expect it to be very rare. Good hunting.
